description: Presents collapsible speaker notes above a presentation's mode menu.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
<tp-slide-note legend="Speaker notes" lang="en-GB" show-text>
  <script type="tp/txt">Introduce the idea. [trigger=clic] Explain the next step.</script>
</tp-slide-note>

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Expands the notes panel; closing it does not stop narration.

cssproperties.name: --tp-slide-note-gap
cssproperties.description: = .5rem - Space between docked notes and the presentation menu.

dependencies.name: tp-text-to-speech
dependencies.summary: Reads textual component content aloud with the Web Speech API.

userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Notes summary | Expand or collapse the transcript and speech controls. Closing the panel keeps narration running. |
| Speech controls | Use the text-to-speech component's Speak, Pause, Resume, Stop and voice settings. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Focus the notes summary and available speech controls. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> on the summary | Expand or collapse the panel. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |

keyboard.description: Expands or collapses the focused notes summary.
